findings.highlight: reached our final destination
findings.evidenceJa: この場所に辿り着いた
findings.governingReading: reached this place
findings.explanation: The English declares a final destination where the source only identifies the present place.

findings.highlight: sweat dripping down my neck
findings.evidenceJa: 冷たい汗が流れている
findings.governingReading: cold sweat runs down his neck
findings.explanation: The physical sign of dread loses its temperature.

findings.highlight: The wind coming down from the mountain gate is warm, and the shaking trees seem like breathing lungs.
findings.evidenceJa: 一歩踏み出す度に走る悪寒と、息苦しいまでの圧迫感
findings.governingReading: Each step sends a chill through him under suffocating pressure.
findings.explanation: An elaborate warm-wind and breathing-tree image absent from the active Japanese is inserted.

findings.highlight: his MasterKotomine
findings.evidenceJa: マスター言峰を討つ
findings.governingReading: strike down his Master, Kotomine
findings.explanation: The title and name are fused into malformed English.

findings.highlight: I cannot allow him to beat me
findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=か]彼の王に膝を屈する事はできません
findings.governingReading: She cannot bend the knee to that king.
findings.explanation: Saber’s refusal of royal submission becomes a generic refusal to lose.

findings.highlight: even if Saber diesif I defeat Kotomine
findings.evidenceJa: もしセイバーが倒れたとしても俺が言峰を倒せば
findings.governingReading: even if Saber falls, if Shirou defeats Kotomine
findings.explanation: The conditional clauses are fused.

findings.highlight: The red phosphorescence scatters on the wind, and the grounds is too bright for nighttime.
findings.evidenceJa: 吹き荒ぶ風は勢いを増し、その源はあの光境内の奥のようだ
findings.governingReading: The raging wind intensifies; its source seems to be that light, deeper in the grounds.
findings.explanation: The English adds scattered phosphorescence and excessive nighttime brightness absent from the active page.

findings.highlight: wishing me her best
findings.evidenceJa: 無事を祈る
findings.governingReading: praying for his safety
findings.explanation: A specific prayer that Shirou survive becomes a vague encouragement.

findings.highlight: the lake is holy as if a dragon king lives in it
findings.evidenceJa: 龍神でも棲んでいそうな池
findings.governingReading: a pond with a sacred air, as though a dragon deity might dwell there
findings.explanation: The place and religious figure are both changed.

findings.highlight: that’s all in the past
findings.evidenceJa: それは昨日までの話
findings.governingReading: that was true until yesterday
findings.explanation: A precise recent boundary becomes indefinite past.

findings.highlight: My calm mind instantly goes over the limit
findings.evidenceJa: 冷静を演じてきた思考が、一瞬にして[ruby text=レート o2o=1]通常値を振り切る
findings.governingReading: His thought, which had been performing calm, instantly exceeds its normal rate.
findings.explanation: The feigned calm and written/ruby rate relation disappear.

findings.highlight: Let Illya down.
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤを降ろせ
findings.governingReading: Put Illya down.
findings.explanation: The English inserts a glare absent from the active Japanese page.

findings.highlight: unless she bears this until she dies
findings.evidenceJa: 命の続く限り耐えてもらわねば
findings.governingReading: she must endure it for as long as her life continues
findings.explanation: A duration bounded by continued life is made an explicit death endpoint.

findings.highlight: The mud slashed like a whip
findings.evidenceJa: 泥は鞭のようにしなり
findings.governingReading: The mud flexes and lashes like a whip.
findings.explanation: Elastic movement is changed to cutting.

findings.highlight: Damnyou fake priest
findings.evidenceJa: このエセ神父
findings.governingReading: You sham priest…!
findings.explanation: The insult is fused into malformed English.

findings.highlight: unless you have something major
findings.evidenceJa: 何かで掛け算でもしないかぎり、埋められる[ruby text=さ char=2]数値ではあるまい
findings.governingReading: not a numerical gap he can close unless he multiplies his years by something
findings.explanation: The mathematical taunt, ruby, and experience gap mechanism disappear.

findings.highlight: I can’t even tell if it’s there
findings.evidenceJa: カカトから先がくっついているかさえ判らなかった
findings.governingReading: He cannot tell whether everything from the heel onward is still attached.
findings.explanation: The precise feared extent of bodily loss disappears.

findings.highlight: forces my dizzy head awake
findings.evidenceJa: 目眩を起こす頭をしぼって、立ち上がって
findings.governingReading: He strains his reeling head and stands.
findings.explanation: Deliberate cognitive effort and standing are replaced by involuntary awakening.

findings.highlight: That must have been the end of this attack
findings.evidenceJa: それで追撃は止んだのか
findings.governingReading: Had that stopped the follow-up attack?
findings.explanation: A question is promoted to a confident conclusion.

findings.highlight: It’s about to go out on its own
findings.evidenceJa: 喉から這い上がってきそうな勢い
findings.governingReading: as though his heart might crawl up and out through his throat
findings.explanation: The grotesque bodily route and crawling image disappear.

findings.highlight: I’m not going to hold back on using the ‘projection’ magic
findings.evidenceJa: 出し惜しみなんてしていない
findings.governingReading: He is not withholding Projection now.
findings.explanation: Present inability despite willingness becomes future intent.

findings.highlight: the source of it is that lightcoming from the back of the grounds
findings.evidenceJa: その源はあの光境内の奥のようだ
findings.governingReading: Its source seems to be that light, deeper in the grounds.
findings.explanation: Two phrases are fused into malformed English.

findings.highlight: waiting for usno, for Saber
findings.evidenceJa: 俺たちいや、セイバーを待ち受けていた
findings.governingReading: waiting for us—no, for Saber
findings.explanation: The viewpoint correction is fused.

findings.highlight: lowlife
findings.evidenceJa: 雑種
findings.governingReading: mongrel
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s recurring status insult is changed.

findings.highlight: The “void” created in the air
findings.evidenceJa: 中空に穿たれた『孔』
findings.governingReading: the “hole” bored into midair
findings.explanation: A bounded opening central to Grail mechanics becomes an abstract void.

findings.highlight: stab him in the chest
findings.evidenceJa: その胸を断つしかない
findings.governingReading: sever his chest
findings.explanation: The planned cutting strike is changed to stabbing.

findings.highlight: your wishthat black mud
findings.evidenceJa: おまえの願いその黒い泥を
findings.governingReading: your wish—that black mud
findings.explanation: The appositional identification is fused.

findings.highlight: There is no reason to explain things
findings.evidenceJa: わざわざ説いてやる真理はない
findings.governingReading: There is no truth he will go out of his way to expound.
findings.explanation: Kotomine’s contemptuous withholding of truth becomes generic explanation.

findings.highlight: I jump
findings.evidenceJa: 咄嗟で地面を蹴った
findings.governingReading: Reflexively, he kicks off the ground.
findings.explanation: The triggering physical action and reflex disappear.

findings.highlight: someone who is pleading for their life
findings.evidenceJa: 助けを求める者
findings.governingReading: someone who asks for help
findings.explanation: Kotomine narrows a broad appeal for aid into explicit begging for life.

findings.highlight: The quivering mud coming from the lake
findings.evidenceJa: 池から鎌首をあげて揺らめくそれ
findings.governingReading: It sways up from the pond with its hooded head raised.
findings.explanation: The black-snake posture is omitted.

findings.highlight: He releases the black snakes
findings.evidenceJa: 一斉に、黒い蛇たちを解放した
findings.governingReading: He releases all the black snakes at once.
findings.explanation: The coordinated simultaneity of the attack disappears.

findings.highlight: mud comes splashing toward me, telling me I cannot let myself stop
findings.evidenceJa: 止まる事など許さない、と無数の泥が振り下ろされた
findings.governingReading: Countless streams of mud swing down as if refusing to allow him to stop.
findings.explanation: The mud’s hostile pressure becomes Shirou instructing himself.

findings.highlight: I raise myself
findings.evidenceJa: アゴをあげて
findings.governingReading: He jerks/raises his chin.
findings.explanation: A precise evasive movement becomes whole-body elevation.

findings.highlight: requires at least one minute of concentration
findings.evidenceJa: 最短でも一分近い精神集中
findings.governingReading: requires nearly a minute of concentration even at minimum
findings.explanation: The estimate is lengthened and its approximation reversed.

findings.highlight: I won’t know if I’m dead or not
findings.evidenceJa: 自分が生きているか死んでいるかさえ判らなくなる
findings.governingReading: He will no longer know whether he is alive or dead.
findings.explanation: The paired existential uncertainty is narrowed to checking death.

findings.highlight: Owdamn, oh
findings.evidenceJa: てつ、あ
findings.governingReading: A broken cry of pain.
findings.explanation: Unsupported profanity replaces an inarticulate cry.

findings.highlight: many snakes show their veins
findings.evidenceJa: 蛇が鎌首をもたげた
findings.governingReading: The snakes raise their hooded heads.
findings.explanation: A threatening snake posture becomes nonsensical exposed veins.

findings.highlight: My right ankle is unbelievably black
findings.evidenceJa: 右足が、信じられないぐらい真っ黒
findings.governingReading: His right leg/foot is unbelievably black.
findings.explanation: The affected bodily extent is narrowed to the ankle.

findings.highlight: drowns my despair
findings.evidenceJa: 絶望に渇いたオレを潤した
findings.governingReading: The mud moistens “me,” parched by despair.
findings.explanation: A grotesque hydration metaphor acting on Shirou is changed into drowning an abstract emotion.
